DECISIVE_FINDING_data_integrity_audit.claim_tested: eps_static (RadonPy ground-truth label used by the shipped mixed-openpoly-radonpy-dielectric-conformal-kpi) is a physically valid zero-frequency dielectric constant
DECISIVE_FINDING_data_integrity_audit.refute_criterion: eps_static < n_measured^2 for a material is thermodynamically impossible (Frohlich 1949 Ch.2 / Debye 1929: eps(0) >= eps(optical) always, since static permittivity = electronic polarization + non-negative orientational polarization)
DECISIVE_FINDING_data_integrity_audit.observed: 962/1075 = 89.5% of RadonPy static_dielectric_const values VIOLATE this inequality
DECISIVE_FINDING_data_integrity_audit.contrast: OpenPoly's own internally-consistent DFT decomposition (eps_Total vs eps_Electronic) has 0/295 violations
DECISIVE_FINDING_data_integrity_audit.interpretation: RadonPy's MD fluctuation-formula static dielectric constant is under-converged for the large majority of (weakly-)polar polymers -- collapsing toward the electronic-only limit or below it -- and cannot serve as ground truth for a physics-vs-ML dielectric comparison as the C8 objective assumed. This is a property of the ground-truth LABELS, not of either predictor; it means the physics-vs-ML-vs-stack numbers below (like the existing shipped ML KPI they are compared to) are being scored against partially-invalid targets on ~90% of the RadonPy population.
